method.title: How e dey work
method.intro: How Proof of Signal dey measure network, predict am, and reason about uploads wey miss for election night, for simple language.
method.measureBody: Volunteers wey get Android app dey visit polling units between 17:00 and 23:59, the time wey dem dey upload results. The app dey send 1.5 MB file, like the size of result sheet photo, through each SIM go our probe server, and e go record whether e reach inside 10 minutes. The phone dey sign each test, e tie to one-time code, and we dey check location, time and the network wey e use. Unit go count as measured for one network after three tests wey we accept.
method.predictBody: Most units nobody go visit. For those ones, statistical model dey predict the chance to upload from measurement wey near, where network towers dey, and the land, and e go give range. If the range wide, e mean say we no sabi much. The best-network chance combine all networks: the chance say at least one go work.
method.freezeBody: Before election day, we dey freeze the predictions inside one snapshot. We dey publish im SHA-256 hash for down with time-stamp, so anybody fit check say nothing change after results start to come.
method.nightBody: One watcher dey check IReV every two minutes. For each unit wey never reach, e dey weigh three reasons: network failure (e fit be when network weak and the units wey near am never reach too), general server or processing delay (e fit be when plenty units wey get good network still dey wait), and something else. If units wey get good network and units wey get weak network stop to upload at the same time, the watcher go announce say everywhere don pause and e go hold judgement.
method.reviewBody: Units wey network or general delay no explain the waiting dey go to trained reviewers from accredited observer groups. Dem fit mark am as "e get explanation" (with reason), dismiss am, or confirm concern. To confirm, two different reviewers must agree. Every decision dey enter hash-chained audit log.

limits.coverage: We dey measure network for the weeks before election. Network fit change.
limits.sample: Prediction fit wrong; the range dey show how far e fit wrong.
limits.finding: Flag na request for person to review, e no be finding.
limits.votes: We no dey ever collect or show vote numbers.

method.auditIntro: Every day, we dey seal the audit log inside one root hash, and independent authority dey time-stamp am (RFC 3161).
